# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

class RequestId
  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    status, headers, body = @app.call(env)
    [status, headers.merge("x-request-id" => SecureRandom.uuid), body]
  end
end
